[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Capture t:<type> task-type markers with configured-type completion[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]Typing `t:` at either edge of any capture line opens a fast, [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]beautiful menu of your configured task types in Bob Mac Capture [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim](and zsh). The accepted `t:fix` marker types the task the item [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]creates or targets, and the live preview says exactly what will [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]happen. Existing Task Links stay in agreement with the new type, [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]and adding `t:` never changes what the rest of the draft means.[/#D7D7AF]

[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]bob-cli t:<type> grammar, parse spans, and new-task typing[/bold #D7AFFF]    [bold white on #D75F87] large  [/bold white on #D75F87]
    [#AF87FF]grammar[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]grammar: lex `t:<type>` at line edges with one shared lexer, mask it out[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]of the execution, editor, and completion parse paths without moving byte[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]offsets, emit the `task_type` span, need, and diagnostics, type newly [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]captured tasks (including the named-Pomodoro agreement rule), refuse [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]non-task items with teaching errors, and document the marker.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]bob-cli retyping of targeted existing tasks with D8 relocation[bold black on #FFD75F][/bold #D7AFFF] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]existing[dim] · [dim][/dim]after grammar[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]existing: let `t:` retype the existing task an item targets (whole-item [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]links, Ensure Next, toggle, relationship owners), and share the D8 [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]relocation applier with `bob task move` so the task's live Task Link [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]keeps agreeing with its type.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]bob-cli task_type completion context and zsh rows[/bold #D7AFFF]             [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]complete[dim] · [dim][/dim]after grammar[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]complete: add the `task_type` capture-complete context with [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]configured-type candidates, current, inherited, and effect annotations, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]a typed-name row, lossless replacements, and zsh completion rows.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Bob Mac Capture t:<type> painting, type menu, and preview[/bold #D7AFFF]     [bold white on #D75F87] large  [/bold white on #D75F87]

    [#D7D7AF]all.[/#D7D7AF]
